error.title: E lē o avanoa le upega tafa'ilagi
error.description: Ae paga lea, na tupu se mea sesē e le'i faatalitalia a o utaina lenei itulau. Matou te faamalie atu mo so o se faalavelave. Faamolemole toe taumafai e ulufale i le upega tafa'ilagi i se taimi mulimuli ane, pe kiliki iinei e toe utaina ai le itulau.

suspended.title: Ua taofia le upega tafa'ilagi
suspended.description: Ae paga lea, e lē o avanoa le upega tafa'ilagi o loo e taumafai e asiasi i ai. Matou te faamalie atu mo so o se faalavelave. Afai o oe o lē e ana lenei upega tafa'ilagi, faamolemole faafesoota'i le vaega fesoasoani.

over_bandwidth.title: Ua taofia le upega tafa'ilagi
over_bandwidth.description: Ae paga lea, e lē o avanoa le upega tafa'ilagi o loo e taumafai e asiasi i ai. Matou te faamalie atu mo so o se faalavelave. Afai o oe o lē e ana lenei upega tafa'ilagi, faamolemole faafesoota'i le vaega fesoasoani.

backend.title: E lē o avanoa le server
backend.description: E lē o avanoa mo sina taimi le server autū e maua mai ai le upega tafa'ilagi, o lea e lē mafai ai ona tali i lenei talosaga. Matou te faamalie atu mo so o se faalavelave.

clienttimeout.title: Ua uma le taimi faatulagaina mo le talosaga
clienttimeout.description: Faamalie atu, na uma le taimi faatulagaina a o utaina lenei itulau o le upega tafa'ilagi. Matou te faamalie atu mo so o se faalavelave na ono tupu mai ai.

forbidden.title: Ua lē faatagaina le ulufale
forbidden.description: E lē o iai sau faatagaga e ulufale ai i lenei itulau. Afai ua sesē lenei mea, faamolemole faafesoota'i le pule o le upega tafa'ilagi.

upstream.title: E lē o avanoa le server
upstream.description: E leai se server o loo i luga o le upega ma avanoa i le taimi nei e faatino ai lenei talosaga. Matou te faamalie atu mo so o se faalavelave.

invalid_configuration.title: Ua sesē faatulagaga
invalid_configuration.description: E lē mafai ona matou faatinoina lenei talosaga ona ua sesē faatulagaga. Matou te faamalie atu mo so o se faalavelave.

resource.title: Sesē i le ulufale
resource.description_start: Ae paga lea, na tupu se mea sesē a o utaina lenei itulau.
cause_list: Ua tele galuega e le'i faatalitalia o loo feagai ma le server autū, ma e lē mafai ona faatino talosaga i le taimi nei
Na tupu se mea sesē e le'i faatalitalia i le server autū po o le taimi na auina atu ai faamatalaga
resource.description_end: Matou te faamalie atu mo so o se faalavelave.

resource_limitrate.title: Sesē i le ulufale
resource_limitrate.description_start: Ae paga lea, na tupu se mea sesē a o utaina lenei itulau.
cause_list: Ua iloa o loo auina mai se aofa'iga tele naua o talosaga i le server mai lau tuatusi IP
Ua tele galuega e le'i faatalitalia o loo feagai ma le server autū, ma e lē mafai ona faatino talosaga i le taimi nei
Na tupu se mea sesē e le'i faatalitalia i le server autū po o le taimi na auina atu ai faamatalaga
resource_limitrate.description_end: Matou te faamalie atu mo so o se faalavelave.

resource_limitcon.title: Sesē i le ulufale
resource_limitcon.description_start: Ae paga lea, na tupu se mea sesē a o utaina lenei itulau.
cause_list: E lē masani ai le aofa'iga o fesoota'iga i le server mai lau tuatusi IP
Ua tele galuega e le'i faatalitalia o loo feagai ma le server autū, ma e lē mafai ona faatino talosaga i le taimi nei
Na tupu se mea sesē e le'i faatalitalia i le server autū po o le taimi na auina atu ai faamatalaga
resource_limitcon.description_end: Matou te faamalie atu mo so o se faalavelave.

ssl-https-http.title: Ua lē sa'o le talosaga
ssl-https-http.description: E mafai ona ulufale i lenei upega tafa'ilagi e ala i le HTTPS. Na e taumafai e fesoota'i e ala i le HTTP, ma o le a matou taumafai nei e toe faasino atu oe. Afai e lē toe faasino atu oe, faaopoopo le https:// i le amataga o lau URL ma toe taumafai.

timeout.title: E lē o avanoa le server
timeout.description: Faamalie atu, na uma le taimi faatulagaina a o utaina lenei itulau. Atonu o loo pisi le server ma e lē mafai ona faatino lau talosaga i le taimi nei.

unknown_domain.title: E lē iloa le igoa o le domain
unknown_domain.description: E le'i resitalaina lenei domain i lenei tuatusi IP.

unsupported_method.title: E lē lagolagoina le auala
unsupported_method.description: E le'i kiina mo lenei upega tafa'ilagi le auala HTTP na talosagaina.

ssl-insecure.title: E lē malupuipuia le talosaga
ssl-insecure.description: E le'i kiina mo lenei upega tafa'ilagi le protocol HTTPS na talosagaina. Faamolemole faafou lau polokalame su'esu'e.

maintenance.title: Ua lē i luga o le upega ona o galuega faaleleia
maintenance.description: E lē o avanoa lenei upega tafa'ilagi i le taimi nei. Ua faamoemoe e toe avanoa i se taimi lata mai.
